items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 44:1
items.html: In every degree there are three discernments of IBM [impregnation, nursing, Mochin] of the back, and likewise IBM of the front. For the degree divides in its entirety into VAK and GAR: the IBM of the VAK are called the IBM of the back, and in their entirety they are called the discernment of the vessels of the degree, or the discernment of its body; and the IBM of the GAR are called the IBM of the front, and in their entirety they are called the discernment of the Mochin and lights of the degree. And the IBM of the back are also called by the name the three garments of the body, and the IBM of the front are called the three garments of the Mochin. (Item 165).
